## Room Name
The name of the room to implement (e.g. The Music Library).

## Room Description
Brief description of the room's theme and atmosphere.

## Puzzles to Implement

## Assets Needed
- Room image: already exists in `music-escape-room/src/assets/`
- Any additional images or icons needed

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Room is accessible via the rooms grid
- [ ] At least 2–3 interactive puzzles are implemented
- [ ] Each puzzle has correct and incorrect feedback states
- [ ] Room has a completion/escape state when all puzzles are solved
- [ ] Room is responsive on mobile devices
- [ ] Keyboard navigation works correctly
